description.value: Vancouver Island Refillery is a health food and refill shop on Wesley Street in Nanaimo, operating under a zero-waste, bring-your-own-container retail concept. The store has a membership program and an online shop, suggesting a community-oriented operation appealing to sustainability-minded shoppers. For touring cyclists, it represents a stop for health-oriented supplies in central Nanaimo.
